tool_args.rationale: The open-branch and trajectory observations establish a strong s_grad effect alongside saturating response in u_now. The recalled two-layer siphon law matches the bridge-supply signature and is identifiable from the observed spans, so fit its three free parameters numerically and use fresh confirmation rather than buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid rows already vary both u_now and s_grad over useful ranges; the archive candidate siphon mechanisms are directly fit-able, so another batch is not necessary before testing confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Quadratic surface in u_now and s_grad
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It was already refuted on fresh confirmation (RMSE 0.107587 > 0.045) and does not encode the observed saturating supply and gradient-inhibition structure.

considered_alternatives.option: Two-layer inland-hub siphon with negative/open branch or hydraulic-basin twin
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The positive square-root branch is the economical candidate; fit-and-confirm will test its branch sign and whether the basin twin's constrained rho is compatible.
